attributes.residual: CLOSED, real 0, EXACT. 39/39 instructions, opcode multiset identical, 15 differing words in two mechanisms: one four-atom prologue reorder at +0x8..+0x18 and 11 words of renaming. Ours issues `mtctr r0`, `li r4,0`, `lwz r5,48(r3)`, `lis r6,buttons@ha`; retail issues the lis first, then mtctr, lwz, li. THE ONE NON-OBVIOUS SOUNDNESS QUESTION IS THE mtctr AND IT WAS INSTRUMENTED RATHER THAN ASSUMED: webfrank._word_effects decodes opcode-31 xo 467 as an SPR write and maps SPR 9 to 'ctr', so the CTR write IS modelled; CTR is written exactly once in the region, so its final writer is unchanged by the move and check_permutation_dependences accepts at exit_dead=None, which admits no escape for a moved final write. The remaining 11 words exchange the two record-pointer webs (g5<->g4) and shift the buttons base g6->g4 through the store chain, machine-proven by verify_consistent_recolor with no audit escape.
